snippet.title: Malhaar - Official Demo Trailer | Game Devs of Color Expo 2026
snippet.description: Watch the Malhaar trailer for this upcoming musical slice-of-life RPG where you play as a musician and luthier who has just arrived in the mystical city that lives and breathes music. Befriend locals, solve puzzles and unravel the mysterious stories of the lingering musical spirits that only appear during the season of the fireflies. Malhaar will be available on PC, and a demo is out now on Steam.
